items.title: Ukrainian war orphans' long road to healing: 'We don't talk to him about his parents' death. We wait for him to ask questions'
items.description: Thousands of Ukrainian children, whose parents were killed in the war, have been cared for in public orphanages with a post-Soviet structure, by foster families, or by non-profit organizations that have tried to heal their psychological wounds.

items.title: Ukraine Hopes Oleshky Can Serve As Model For Wider Truce, Delegation Says In DC
items.description: Ukraine hopes a temporary cease-fire that enabled humanitarian aid deliveries and civilian evacuations from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky could serve as a model for wider de-escalation efforts, Ukrainian officials said on November 6.
